name: anti-ai-defensive-writing
title_zh: 删掉AI腔的防御性写作：不请自来的免责声明
tagline_zh: 审稿人一眼看穿「这是AI写的」的六个信号：过度自谦、虚构指标、无端强调、空泛抽象。专治摘要、方法、结果。
tagline_en: Six tells that scream "AI wrote this"—reflexive hedging, invented metrics, italicized drama. Cleans abstracts.
desc_en: Draft or revise academic writing without unrequested AI defensiveness: reflexive caveats, unsupported statistical machinery, invented metrics or probes, rhetorical insertions that manufacture cadence, gratuitous em dashes or italics, opaque abstraction, and claims weakened below what the evidence supports. Use for cleaning AI-generated abstracts, papers, methods, results, captions, tables, and con
why_zh: 不是改措辞，是删机制：它识别并移除AI为显得严谨而加的防御层——那些不支撑结论的统计脚手架和修辞拐杖。
why_en: Not a thesaurus swap—it excises the defensive machinery AI adds to seem rigorous: unsupported stats, cadence fillers, hedged.
limit_zh: 只处理学术写作的AI防御性痕迹，不重写内容、不补实验、不改逻辑。对刻意模仿人类风格的AI文本可能漏检。
limit_en: Only strips AI-defensive tics in academic prose. Won't rewrite content, fix logic, or add experiments. May miss text deliberately mimicking human.
title_en: Strip AI defensiveness from academic prose: caveats, fake.
